permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Load departures, connections and place search from Transitous (MOTIS), and walking directions from the OpenStreetMap routing server of FOSSGIS e.V.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Find the stops near you, plan routes from where you are, guide you on foot and by vehicle, and follow the next stop while riding.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Record the destination you say, only while you hold the touchpad on the destinations page. The recording is sent to a speech-to-text server you set up and is not stored.
